3457-4613-6857.easyPrerequisites:
Kragma Butcher doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Seeker of Skybreak is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
3457-4613-6857.description:
Activate Kragma Butcher using Seeker of Skybreak's ability by tapping it, untapping Kragma Butcher
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

997-2586-4186.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat

2033-4687-5296.notablePrerequisites: Workhorse has at least four counters on it.
2033-4687-5296.description:
Activate Citanul Hierophants by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Workhorse, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3192-4247-6972.easyPrerequisites: The number of red creatures you control excluding Ulasht plus the number of green creatures you control excluding Ulasht is at least X.
3192-4247-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Ulasht.
When Ulasht dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4247-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4247-6719.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1308-2557-3129-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

129-1409-4289-4785.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1368-4927-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4927-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3446-3532-5078-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2769-3259-6968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2769-3259-6968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two creature tokens
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

225-2570-3519-5531.description:
Activate Food Chain by exiling Lumra, adding seven {G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return Lumra to the command zone from exile.
Activate Command Beacon's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Lumra from the command zone into your hand.
Cast Lumra by paying {4}{G}{G}.
When Lumra enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger that many times, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Command Beacon.
Repeat.

81-1495-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

654-678-5231-6644.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise, adding {R}.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is a creature without summoning sickness

478-539-1355--111.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three enchantments.
478-539-1355--111.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

3875-4772-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
3875-4772-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
3875-4772-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner each trigger twice.
Resolve both Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

2103-2493-2963.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

423-511-3510-4109.notablePrerequisites: Either Sporoloth Ancient or Deathspore Thallid has at least three spore counters on it, with the other having at least two spore counters on it.
423-511-3510-4109.description:
Activate either Deathspore Thallid or Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Life and Limb, Evolution Sage triggers, putting a spore counter on Deathspore Thallid and Sporoloth Ancient.
Repeat.

549-803-1558-3413.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures.
"Human" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
549-803-1558-3413.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five creatures.
Xathrid Necromancer triggers five times, creating five 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

813-1810-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
813-1810-4276.description:
Activate all mana producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages.
The Scholar of the Ages token enters the battlefield, returning Turnabout and Cackling Counterpart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1703-2034-4984.notablePrerequisites: Fool's Demise attached to Academy Researchers.
1703-2034-4984.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Academy Researchers, adding {C}{C}.
Academy Researchers dies, triggering Fool's Demise first and second abilities.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Academy Researchers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Academy Researchers enters the battlefield, putting Fool's Demise onto the battlefield from your hand attached to Academy Researchers.
Repeat.

1082-3487-4374.description:
Cast Aetherstorm Roc by paying {2}{W}{W}.
Aetherstorm Roc enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Dual Nature.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Aetherstorm Roc.
The Aetherstorm Roc token enters the battlefield, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the nontoken Aetherstorm Roc trigger from step 2, causing you to get {E}.
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
If there are any Aethergeode Miner tokens on the battlefield, Dual Nature triggers, exiling the token(s).
Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, triggering both Aetherstorm Rocs and Dual Nature.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Aethergeode Miner.
The Aethergeode Miner token enters the battlefield, triggering both Aetherstorm Rocs, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Resolve the Aetherstorm Roc triggers from step 8, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat from step 6.

557-3846.notablePrerequisites:
Atemsis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least six different cards with different mana values in library and/or hand.
An opponent cannot block and kill Atemsis.
557-3846.description:
Cast Diabolic Revelation by paying at most {9}{B}{B}, searching your library for at most six cards with differing mana values and putting them into your hand.
Move to your combat phase, and deal combat damage to an opponent with Atemsis.
Atemsis triggers, revealing your hand and causing the opponent dealt combat damage to lose the game.
